summary.text: Tom Patton represents Ohio's 24th Senate District, which encompasses portions of western Cuyahoga County including his hometown of Strongsville, and chairs the Senate Transportation Committee. He has over two decades of experience in the Ohio General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: A lifelong Cuyahoga County resident, Patton grew up as one of nine kids on the near west side of Cleveland and is the son of a Cleveland police officer.
He first served in the Ohio Senate in 2008 and has served as Majority Floor Leader.

During the 131st General Assembly he sponsored Senate Bill 27 on presumption of cancer as a duty-related condition for disabled firefighters, and he was the primary sponsor of the bill that authorized use of a "land bank" to help counties contend with the foreclosure crisis.
He raised five daughters and one son in Strongsville and has ten grandchildren.
